name: Little Cultus Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251722 (111 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes NF (Bend-Fort Rock RD) campground on Little Cultus Lake, Cascade Lakes area. ~28 nonelectric sites, no hookups; sites accommodate RVs/trailers 24-40 ft. Vault toilets, potable water, boat launch. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Little Lava Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233215 (136 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: Deschutes NF (Bend-Fort Rock RD) campground on Little Lava Lake (headwaters of the Deschutes River). 15 nonelectric sites, no hookups; gravel back-in drives, max spur 40 ft. Vault toilets, boat ramp. Reservable, FCFS after late Sept. Rough dirt access road. --Claude

name: Cultus Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251580 (111 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS Deschutes NF campground on the NE shore of Cultus Lake in the Cascade Lakes area (RV Life lists city as Blue River but it is on the Cascade Lakes Hwy near Bend). 55 sites for tents/trailers/RVs; sites and roads are narrow so RVs over 30 ft not recommended (max spur ~40 ft). Reservable via recreation.gov, becomes FCFS late Sept. --Claude

name: Camp Sherman Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233198 (333 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes National Forest (Sisters RD) campground on the Metolius River at Camp Sherman. About 15 sites for RV/tent (one tent-only), max site spur 40 ft, vault toilets and drinking water, no electric hookups. Reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Gorge Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 267083 (118 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes National Forest (Sisters RD) campground on the Metolius River near Camp Sherman. About 18 sites for RV/trailer/tent, picnic tables and fire rings, vault toilets, no potable water (bring your own), no hookups. Reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Contorta Flat Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251567 (116 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes NF (Crescent RD) campground on the south shore of Crescent Lake near Contorta Point, ~19 sites, pit toilets, no hookups. 14 sites accommodate RVs/trailers 24-40 ft; some tent sites right on the lake. Reservable via recreation.gov (FCFS late season). --Claude

name: Trapper Creek Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233195 (118 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes NF (Crescent Ranger District) at the west end of Odell Lake where Trapper Creek enters; ~29 sites, drinking water, vault toilets, boat launch, no hookups. Sites accommodate RVs 22-40 ft (max spur 40 ft). Reservable online (becomes first-come, first-served after late Sept). --Claude

name: Allen Springs Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251577 (333 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes NF (Sisters Ranger District) along the Metolius River near Camp Sherman; 16 sites, vault toilets, no onsite water, no hookups. Max site spur 36 ft, but only a few sites (e.g. 7, 9, 11, 12, 13) fit smaller RVs/trailers — most are better for tents. Reservable online, open year-round. --Claude

name: Lower Bridge Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 266139 (332 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes NF (Sisters RD) campground on the Metolius River at the Lower Bridge crossing; max site spur length 30 ft, vault toilets, potable water available, no hookups. Reservable online (season ~May-Sep). --Claude

name: Quinn River Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251433 (125 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes NF campground on the west shore of Crane Prairie Reservoir (Cascade Lakes Hwy). ~41 sites, no hookups, drinking water + vault toilets, boat ramp; max site spur 30 ft (some sites longer). Reservable online. --Claude
